Folks — quick pipeline hygiene note before our weekly forecast lock:

Thanks Marcus for getting Elena's confirmation. Two operational asks from Deal Desk/Finance so we can safely count this as a commit in Oct:

• Written approval: Need a single email thread from the customer acknowledging the final net price, term, and invoicing cadence. Elena's reply qualifies if Finance doesn't condition the discount on any additional fee changes.
• Risk adjustment: Because Stella requested net‑30 instead of prepay, we should apply a 5% revenue timing haircut to the Oct committed ARR (per forecast rules) unless Finance signs an invoice schedule confirming month‑1 recognition. Please call out the adjusted ARR number for reporting.
• Legal/COMMS: If legal redlines are limited to SOC2 scope + standard data deletion language, treat them as non‑commercial and proceed. If legal requests price or term changes, escalate to Deal Desk immediately.

Marcus, can you please: 1) confirm the written approval will come from Finance on the same thread, and 2) update the attached quote to show both the committed ARR number and the post‑haircut ARR we should report? I attached a short Deal Desk checklist for clarity.
